name: work-line-routing
description: Add hybrid user-invoked and AI-detected Epic, MNT, OPS, and ADV work-line routing with supporting skills and records.
notes: Explicit skill invocation and AI classification route to the same work-line procedures.
When --ai-surface is omitted, existing .agents/skills and .claude/skills directories are detected.
Existing customized routing documents and skills are preserved and reported as WARN(KEEP).
This feature does not classify or migrate existing tasks automatically.
